s-li.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-li.card_subtitle_as_published: Organic only. Sponsored impressions (Nov 2025–Jun 2026) left out.
s-li.commentary_as_published: October is above September on more posts (56 originals against about 38); reach per post fell. July and August remain the two biggest months.
s-li.source_platform_and_window: LinkedIn page admin analytics (organic), read Oct 28 2026; Oct = Oct 1–26

s-ig.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-ig.commentary_as_published: Below September and well below the spring and summer. Posts with an accepted collaborator averaged 1,634 views against 412 without.
s-ig.source_platform_and_window: Instagram Insights via Supermetrics (IGI 17841471383675991), pulled Oct 30 2026; Oct = Oct 1–27

s-yt.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-yt.commentary_as_published: All organic since September. 60% of the last 28 days' views came from YouTube search.
s-yt.source_platform_and_window: YouTube via Supermetrics (YT2), daily pull; Oct = Oct 1–27; no ADVERTISING traffic since August

s-ga.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-ga.commentary_as_published: Moment Awards voting doubled the site: /vote drew 6,108 views from 4,768 people, and episode pages still grew 13%. Voting ran to Oct 30, after this window.
s-ga.source_platform_and_window: GA4 489265998, native reports, read Oct 28 2026; Oct = Oct 1–27

s-nl.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-nl.commentary_as_published: The step-ups are imports (5,588 of 5,753 October adds; 3,045 on Oct 26–27, after the last send). Open rate fell to 34.4% as the list grew; verified clicks per delivered email held at 0.53%.

s-syn.section_headline: Partners reposted, but rarely with their own words
s-syn.card_title: September: organic vs syndicated engagement, posts with commentary reposts
s-syn.commentary_as_published: September's lift came from WPP Media, Nancy Hall and Versant reposting with their own copy. In October partners mostly reposted without it: 35 syndicated engagements on 1,608 organic. Hand partners and guests repost copy on publish day.

s-sect.commentary_as_published: Ad tech and brands lead. Publicis and IPG voices are missing, and CPG beyond PepsiCo and pharma beyond Organon are thin.
s-sect.source_platform_and_window: October report: post log, monday.com and Teams live links; sector assigned by hand
